text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. I had come to make the 
first shrine visit of the year with 
Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Here's to another year of working hard 
together in perfect tandem with Trainer!
choice_data_list:
(Wishing Ticket stays healthy and cheerful 
again this year)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Done with my wish~~! I'm gonna 
give it my all this year too~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, Trainer, what did 
you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Are you wishing to win in races after 
all?! Or to become even stronger?!

When I honestly told her what I prayed 
for—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm... feeling better...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwooooo---!! I'm so mooooved--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To think you were carin' about me with 
such a kind heart all this tiiiime, 
waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna go pray for your health too, 
Trainerーーー!"

Before I could stop her, she got right 
back into the long queue, and we ended up 
praying at the shrine a second time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight! I prayed for Trainer's 
health, too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally overflowing with 
motivation――!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's a marathon or pulling giant 
tires, I'm ready to take on anything right 
now--!

I don't want to let their enthusiasm go to 
waste. And so—
choice_data_list: Let's relax with everything we've got!

Let's draw those fortunes with all our 
might!

Time to throw myself into learning new 
moves!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Relaxing at full power!? H-Huh!? Aren't 
we gonna train!?"
choice_data_list:
Let's get some good rest today and recover 
our stamina!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is! Got it! I'm 
gonna take a nap with all my might today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, first it's a super dash 
straight to my room~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO~~~~~~!!!

No sooner had she shouted than she dashed 
off toward the academy...!

—Whatever the case, this year is shaping 
up to be a crucial one for her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Draw a fortune with full power?! Ahaha! 
Leave it to meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Great Fortune Great Fortune Great Fortune 
Great Fortuuuune!! Hyahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!

The fortune slip she drew with all her 
might said—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaaat!? I got Excellent 
Luckaaaaaaaah!?

—Whatever the case, this year is shaping 
up to be a crucial one for her!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A new move?! Ahaha, sounds super fun~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But studying, huh... I'm honestly kinda 
bad at that...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no, no, no! I already made up my 
mind to give it my absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! First things first...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's search the bookstore for reference 
books with all our might--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-daaa! When studying with all your 
might, nothing beats a slightly 
challenging specialized book!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, from the perspective of sports 
science, regarding acquired environmental 
factors on fast and slow-twitch muscle 
fibers...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... So sleepy...

—At any rate, this year looks to be an 
important one for Winning Ticket!
